description: Fetch recent container/application logs for an app. Use this to debug crashes, errors, or a deploy that isn't serving.

lines.description: Number of log lines to retrieve (default 100)

name: vibekit_app_logs

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Recent container log lines for the app.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit App Logs
